D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Charles Booker runs furthest behind in Warren, Scott, Boone. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

The forecast's worst groups for Charles Booker: Immigration voters 16 to 84, Small counties 26 to 74, White voters 33 to 67. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
